prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright blue-white glacier ice cave lit by daylight through the ice, a flat frozen floor and a standard-height wooden walkway rail, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Nigerian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a lead small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a silver square-sided cowbell, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin small flared temple bell, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a copper round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked silver hair ornaments. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.

LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Indian Mughal miniature gold-work (a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions), wide gold-and-crimson bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense jewel-toned scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Extremely long almond nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.

The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet.
